description: This file defines the EmployeeTerminationDao class, which provides data access methods for employee termination records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to save a termination record, retrieve a record by ID, and list termination reasons, all utilizing an ORM approach.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationDao
classes.description: Data access object for employee termination records, providing methods to save, retrieve, and list termination reasons.

methods.name: saveEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Persists a given EmployeeTerminationRecord entity into the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeTerminationRecord by its ID; returns null if not found.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Fetches a list of all termination reasons, ordered by name ascending.
